description: Native HumMod diagnostic probe to isolate hypoxic autonomic/cardiovascular response with near-baseline minute ventilation. Not Berlin ARDS calibration.

provenance.purpose: Test native HumMod autonomic/heart-rate response to hypoxemia without severe hypoventilation.
limitations: Inspired oxygen is intentionally low for model characterization and is not a clinical treatment recommendation.
Native HumMod ventilator does not expose PEEP.
